facts.did: 在九十次日出之后，激活返回信标、返回家乡
facts.anchor: activate their return beacon and transit home

facts.did: 转达 Memory 的便条：接下来几次旅程会给一个新簇伴（Cobblestone 未通过 First 已离开）
facts.anchor: The Memory sent a note saying we’d get a new clustermate

facts.did: 到了实验室，把自己的 galaxysuit 接到 Oriel 旁边的工作站，检索在 galaxysuit 上做半透孔的论文
facts.anchor: connected their galaxysuit to the workstation next to Oriel

facts.did: 站在 Gardenpath 上方，问他们为什么在读关于银河采矿（galactic mining）的论文
facts.anchor: Why are you reading papers about galactic mining?

facts.did: 向 Column 和 Oriel 讲述 Unnamed 的排泄仪式：固体被埋掉或冲进海里，液体被储存在缸里再用
facts.anchor: Solid is buried or flushed out to sea

facts.did: 报告 Murtis 的说法：Unnamed 自称 men，用来称人的词就是 men
facts.anchor: they said ‘men.’ The word for people is men.

facts.did: 要求 Gardenpath 绝不可对任何考官提起此事，并说若再犯就亲自向 Academic Senate（学术元老院）举报
facts.anchor: You must never speak of this to any of your examiners

facts.did: 承认自己已经在用微型触手做实验，并进到 Murtis 体内了解其化学
facts.anchor: I have been experimenting already, with a micro-tentacle

relations.relation: 簇伴（clusterbuddy）：招呼并把书扔进 Gardenpath 隔壁的格子
线人与研究对象：Gardenpath 称 Murtis 为线人，并承认进过 Murtis 体内了解其化学
relations.anchor: I did go inside Murtis to learn more about their chemistry

relations.relation: 导师式警告：若再对 Unnamed 打开膜，就亲自向 Academic Senate 举报
relations.anchor: I will report you to the Academic Senate myself

relations.relation: 朋友：搂住 Gardenpath 打闹，几乎进到他们里面
relations.anchor: Oriel almost went inside them as they mock tussled

numbers.fact: 在九十次日出之后，Gardenpath 才得以回家
numbers.anchor: After ninety sunrises, Gardenpath was grateful

numbers.fact: Unnamed 把自己分成两种性别：men 与 women
numbers.anchor: the Unnamed divide themselves up into two genders

numbers.fact: Creska 有数百种性别，并且都精确映射到不同的遗传标记
numbers.anchor: They have hundreds of genders, all mapped precisely

numbers.fact: Column 身上又滑出六只眼睛，全都对着 Gardenpath
numbers.anchor: Six more eyes slid out of their body
